purpose: Mouse MIRI disease input for the Stage 1 MIRI reference DEG list (primary rank reference)

sources.method: GEO acquisition (Affymetrix Clariom S CEL files) followed by the limma pooled IR vs Sham DEG analysis; source/GSE160516_deg_results.csv is the limma output written by script/build_deg.R (the raw CEL inputs are not redistributed)

local_additions.origin: per-GSE MIRI reference DEG list (mouse-to-human ortholog mapped to the L1000 978 landmark genes); tracked before the restructure
UP half of the full mouse-to-human L1000 DEG table; regenerable, never tracked (global *.csv rule)
DOWN half of the full mouse-to-human L1000 DEG table; regenerable, never tracked (global *.csv rule)

notes: GEO ACCESSION: GSE160516 (Mus musculus, Affymetrix Clariom S). This is the workflow's primary rank reference. The gene set is derived by mouse-to-human ortholog mapping (homologene via map_to_human.R:mouse2human) and filtered to the L1000 978 landmarks. Split from the old shared `miri/` level under `disease_data/` in ticket 05 (spec §4).
